facts.fact: The government approved the national cybersecurity strategy and action plan for 2026-2030 by decree no. 2026-0097/PT-RM, per NafoloNews.

The Council of Ministers adopted the texts creating, organising and running the national information systems security agency (ANSSI), which is to coordinate response to cyberattacks, per the official communiqué cited by NafoloNews.
facts.system: Agence nationale de la Sécurité des Systèmes d'Information (ANSSI)
